architecture.type: latent video diffusion UNet (SD 2.1 initialised, temporal layers) + KL image autoencoder with temporally fine-tuned decoder
architecture.representation: VAE encoder latents: 4-channel, 1/8 spatial (f8), computed frame-wise (encoder is an image encoder; only the decoder is temporal); alternatively UNet intermediate features

pretraining_data.summary: Image stage: Stable Diffusion 2.1 initialisation. Video stage: in-house Large Video Dataset (LVD), 580M clips / 212 years, curated to LVD-F; high-res finetune on ~1M-sample 'high-quality video dataset'. Sources of LVD not named.
pretraining_data.form: described only (LVD is internal; no source list)

quotes.quote: We collect an initial dataset of long videos which forms the base data for our video pretraining stage.
The resulting initial dataset, which we dub Large Video Dataset (LVD), consists of 580M annotated video clip pairs, forming 212 years of content.
We finetune the base text-to-video model on a high-quality video dataset of ∼ 1M samples.

All considered potential data sources were included for final training, with none held out as the proposed data filtering methods described in the SVD paper handle the quality control/filtering of the dataset.
we ground our initial model on a pretrained image diffusion model - namely Stable Diffusion 2.1 [71] - to equip it with a strong visual representation.

frame_size.value: 576x1024 (generation / high-res finetune); base video pretraining 256x384 then 320x576; VAE config sample_size 768

quotes.quote: This model was trained to generate 25 frames at resolution 576x1024 given a context frame of the same size, finetuned from [SVD Image-to-Video [14 frames]](https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-video-diffusion-img2vid).
After inserting temporal layers, we then train the model on LVD-F on 14 frames at resolution 256 × 384.
Next, we finetune the model to generate 14 320 × 576 frames for 100k iterations using batch size 768.
"sample_size": 768,

quotes.quote: Additionally, we introduce micro-conditioning [64] on frame rate.

embedding_dim.value: VAE latents: 4 channels x 72 x 128 per 576x1024 frame; 25-frame SVD-XT clip = 4 x 25 x 72 x 128 = 921,600 values (14-frame SVD: 516,096). Alternative representation = UNet intermediate features (dimension depends on the chosen block; not a single documented embedding).
embedding_dim.derivation: latent_channels 4; 4 encoder blocks (3 downsamplings -> f8); frame-wise encoder so latent frames = input frames
